pairs: In illo tempore abiit Jesus per sata sabbato: discipuli autem ejus esurientes cœperunt vellere spicas, et manducare.
At that time, Jesus went out through the ripe grain on the Sabbath. And his disciples, being hungry, began to separate the grain and to eat.
Ecce discipuli tui faciunt quod non licet facere sabbatis.
“Behold, your disciples are doing what is not lawful to do on the Sabbaths.”
“Have you not read what David did,
and those who were with him:
how he entered the house of God
and ate the bread of the Presence,
which was not lawful for him to eat,
neque his qui cum eo erant,
nor for those who were with him,
aut non legistis in lege quia sabbatis sacerdotes in templo sabbatum violant,
Or have you not read in the law, that on the Sabbaths the priests in the temple violate the Sabbath,
that something greater than the temple is here.
And if you knew what this means,
you would never have condemned the innocent.
dominus enim est Filius hominis etiam sabbati.
For the Son of man is Lord even of the Sabbath.”
And when he had passed from there,
Et ecce homo manum habens aridam,
And behold, there was a man who had a withered hand,
and they questioned him, so that they might accuse him,
Si licet sabbatis curare? ut accusarent eum.
saying, “Is it lawful to cure on the Sabbaths?”
et si ceciderit hæc sabbatis in foveam,
if it will have fallen into a pit on the Sabbath,
would not take hold of it and lift it up?
Quanto magis melior est homo ove?
How much better is a man than a sheep? And so,
it is lawful to do good on the Sabbaths.”
Then he said to the man,
“Extend your hand.” And he extended it,
et restituta est sanitati sicut altera.
and it was restored to health, just like the other one.
consilium faciebant adversus eum, quomodo perderent eum.
took council against him, as to how they might destroy him.
But Jesus, knowing this, withdrew from there.
et præcepit eis ne manifestum eum facerent.
And he instructed them, lest they make him known.
Ut adimpleretur quod dictum est per Isaiam prophetam,
Then what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah was fulfilled,
“Behold, my servant whom I have chosen,
dilectus meus, in quo bene complacuit animæ meæ.
my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased.
I will place my Spirit over him,
and he shall announce judgment to the nations.
neque audiet aliquis in plateis vocem ejus:
neither shall anyone hear his voice in the streets.
He shall not crush the bruised reed,
and he shall not extinguish the smoking wick,
until he sends forth judgment unto victory.
et in nomine ejus gentes sperabunt.
And the Gentiles shall hope in his name.”
Tunc oblatus est ei dæmonium habens,
Then one who had a demon,
et curavit eum ita ut loqueretur,
so that he spoke and saw.
And all the crowds were stupefied,
“Could this be the son of David?”
Hic non ejicit dæmones nisi in Beelzebub principe dæmoniorum.
“This man does not cast out demons, except by Beelzebub, the prince of the demons.”
Omne regnum divisum contra se desolabitur:
et omnis civitas vel domus divisa contra se,
“Every kingdom divided against itself will become desolate.
And every city or house divided against itself will not stand.
So if Satan casts out Satan,
then he is divided against himself.
How then will his kingdom stand?
Et si ego in Beelzebub ejicio dæmones,
And if I cast out demons by Beelzebub,
by whom do your own sons cast them out?
Therefore, they shall be your judges.
Si autem ego in Spiritu Dei ejicio dæmones,
But if I cast out demons by the Spirit of God,
igitur pervenit in vos regnum Dei.
then the kingdom of God has arrived among you.
Aut quomodo potest quisquam intrare in domum fortis,
Or how can anyone enter into the house of a strong man,
unless he first restrains the strong man?
And then he will plunder his house.
And whoever does not gather with me,
Every sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven men,
but blasphemy against the Spirit shall not be forgiven.
Et quicumque dixerit verbum contra Filium hominis, remittetur ei:
And anyone who will have spoken a word against the Son of man shall be forgiven.
qui autem dixerit contra Spiritum Sanctum, non remittetur ei,
But whoever will have spoken against the Holy Spirit shall not be forgiven,
For certainly a tree is known by its fruit.
how are you able to speak good things while you are evil?
For out of the abundance of the heart,
ex abundantia enim cordis os loquitur.
Bonus homo de bono thesauro profert bona:
A good man offers good things from a good storehouse.
et malus homo de malo thesauro profert mala.
And an evil man offers evil things from an evil storehouse.
Dico autem vobis quoniam omne verbum otiosum,
that for every idle word which men will have spoken,
reddent rationem de eo in die judicii.
they shall render an account in the day of judgment.
For by your words shall you be justified,
and by your words shall you be condemned.”
Tunc responderunt ei quidam de scribis et pharisæis,
Then certain ones from the scribes and the Pharisees responded to him,
we want to see a sign from you.”
“An evil and adulterous generation seeks a sign.
But a sign will not be given to it,
except the sign of the prophet Jonah.
Sicut enim fuit Jonas in ventre ceti tribus diebus, et tribus noctibus,
For just as Jonah was in the belly of the whale for three days and three nights,
sic erit Filius hominis in corde terræ tribus diebus et tribus noctibus.
so shall the Son of man be in the heart of the earth for three days and three nights.
Viri Ninivitæ surgent in judicio cum generatione ista,
The men of Nineveh shall arise in judgment with this generation,
and they shall condemn it. For,
quia pœnitentiam egerunt in prædicatione Jonæ,
at the preaching of Jonah, they repented. And behold,
et ecce plus quam Jonas hic.
there is a greater than Jonah here.
Regina austri surget in judicio cum generatione ista,
The Queen of the South shall arise in judgment with this generation,
quia venit a finibus terræ audire sapientiam Salomonis,
For she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon. And behold,
et ecce plus quam Salomon hic.
there is a greater than Solomon here.
Cum autem immundus spiritus exierit ab homine,
Now when an unclean spirit departs from a man,
and he does not find it.
And arriving, he finds it vacant,
Tunc vadit, et assumit septem alios spiritus secum nequiores se,
Then he goes and takes with him seven other spirits more wicked than himself,
and they enter in and live there.
et fiunt novissima hominis illius pejora prioribus.
And in the end, the man becomes worse than he was at first. So,
Sic erit et generationi huic pessimæ.
too, shall it be with this most wicked generation.”
While he was still speaking to the crowds,
his mother and his brothers were standing outside,
Ecce mater tua, et fratres tui foris stant quærentes te.
your mother and your brothers are standing outside, seeking you.”
But responding to the one speaking to him,
Et extendens manum in discipulos suos,
And extending his hand to his disciples,
Quicumque enim fecerit voluntatem Patris mei,
For anyone who does the will of my Father,
